control: 'Kitchen board' link of the top bar (GET /kitchen/); the page also opens after Confirm and Back to the board
inputs_validation: none to type; read-only; kitchen role only; the board shows only the staff member's own hub (BR-26); load and capacity count PLACED, CONFIRMED and PREPARING orders (BR-01)
displayed_result: Hub name and 'Kitchen capacity N orders', four columns New, Confirmed, Preparing, Ready for pickup with a count; one card per order with number, placed time, lines, 'Confirm' and 'Reject or replace' (44 px), 'Waiting for the customer' when an offer is open; 'None' for an empty column; no row is written

control: Order number link or 'Reject or replace' link on a card (GET /kitchen/orders/<id>)
inputs_validation: order must exist (404) and belong to the staff member's hub (BR-26: another hub gives 403); read-only
displayed_result: Order page: number, placed time, state badge, payment (COD or ONLINE (paid)), lines with S, F, Q and T, 'Confirm order' (hidden while an offer is open), the 'Offer a replacement' panel with one option per dish and cheaper-or-equal available dish, and the 'Reject the order' panel; no row is written

control: 'Confirm' button on a board card or 'Confirm order' button on the order page (POST /kitchen/orders/<id>/confirm)
inputs_validation: order must be PLACED and of the staff member's hub (BR-26); refused with 'The customer has not answered the replacement offer yet.' while an offer is open; nothing is recomputed or repriced
displayed_result: Back on the board with 'Order N is confirmed.'; the card moves from New to Confirmed; a refusal shows the red message on the board and changes nothing

control: 'Reject order' button of the 'Reject the order' form with the field 'Reason for the customer' (POST /kitchen/orders/<id>/reject); browser confirmation 'Reject order N?'
inputs_validation: reason required and at most 200 characters ('Please give the reason for rejecting the order.'); order must be PLACED and of the own hub (BR-16, BR-26); an open offer is withdrawn; COD becomes voided, ONLINE becomes refund pending with the captured amount owed (BR-17)
displayed_result: Order page with 'Order N is rejected and the customer is told why.', state badge Rejected, payment shown as ONLINE (paid) or COD, the reason line, and only 'Back to the board'

control: 'Send the offer' button of the 'Offer a replacement' form, select 'Replace' with 'dish -> replacement (price)' options (POST /kitchen/orders/<id>/offer)
inputs_validation: a line and a target must be chosen; order PLACED, own hub and no other open offer (BR-26); the source dish must be sold out or unlisted at the hub; the target must be available at the hub, not already in the order and priced the same or lower (plan section 3.3); quantity is unchanged
displayed_result: Order page with 'The replacement is offered. The order waits for the customer's answer.', a highlighted box 'Replacement offered: A -> B. Waiting for the customer to accept or decline.', 'Confirm order' and the offer form hidden, the reject form still available; the order stays PLACED and still counts toward the load (BR-01)

control: 'My orders' link of the customer top bar (GET /order/mine)
inputs_validation: none to type; own orders only; read-only (BR-12 customer role); open replacement offers are marked
displayed_result: Own orders newest first, one row per order on a phone (number, placed time, hub, status badge, total); an order with an open offer carries the badge 'Your answer needed' on the same row (it was off screen before the refinement)

inputs_validation: own order only: another customer's order is refused without disclosing it; read-only; the offer is shown only while it is OFFERED
displayed_result: Order page: a highlighted 'The kitchen asks about a replacement' box with the dish that ran out, the offered dish and both unit prices, the new total next to the current total and the consequence of declining ('the order is not cooked'), buttons 'Accept <dish>' and 'Decline'; below it status, payment, address, lines and totals

control: 'Accept <dish>' button of the offer box (POST /order/<id>/replacement with decision=accept and the offer id)
inputs_validation: decision must be accept or decline (else 400 'Choose accept or decline.'); own PLACED order and the exact open offer (stale or repeated answer refused: 'This replacement offer is no longer open. Nothing was changed.'); the target must still be available (BR-19 keeps old lines as snapshots); if it is not, only the offer is WITHDRAWN and the order and payment stay unchanged; accepted: whole line replaced at the offered price, S and T recomputed, F and Q unchanged, ONLINE amount stays captured
displayed_result: Accepted: order page with 'Replacement accepted. The kitchen may now confirm your order.', new lines and totals, 'Replacement history: A -> B (accepted)'. Dish gone: the notice 'The replacement is no longer available. The offer was withdrawn; your order and payment are unchanged.', old lines kept, history shows 'withdrawn'

control: 'Decline' button of the offer box (POST /order/<id>/replacement with decision=decline)
inputs_validation: own PLACED order and the exact open offer; stale answer refused; atomically offer DECLINED and order REJECTED with the reason 'The customer declined the replacement.' (BR-17: COD voided, ONLINE refund pending for the full captured amount)
displayed_result: Order page with 'Replacement declined. An online captured payment is owed back in full; payout is pending.', status Rejected with the reason, payment 'COD, voided' (or the refund owed for ONLINE), a Finished time, history '(declined)', and no Cancel button
